name: SenClaw Ontology
description: Turn raw data into a real knowledge graph, the right way. Profile a CSV/JSON source, design an ontology (T-Box) from competency questions, map raw rows to RDF with a declarative RML-lite mapping, mint stable IRIs, resolve duplicate entities, validate with SHACL, run RDFS/OWL-RL reasoning, and query everything with SPARQL — all provenance-tracked in per-import named graphs you can drop and reload. Backed by an embedded Oxigraph triple store; the ✨ AI actions (profile roles, draft T-Box, draft mapping, NL→SPARQL, draft SHACL, extract-from-text) run on SenClaw's configured LLM.

mcp.name: ontology-mcp
mcp.description: SenClaw Ontology MCP: build knowledge graphs from raw data. Create projects, add & profile CSV/JSON sources, design a T-Box (classes/properties), author a declarative RML-lite mapping, lift rows into provenance batches, run SPARQL, save & run competency questions as a test suite, validate with SHACL-lite, materialize RDFS/OWL-RL inferences, resolve duplicate entities, and extract triples from unstructured text.
